items.excerpt: UBTech launched its first full-size Ultra-Bionic humanoid robot at a Shenzhen event, pushing an AI-driven consumer humanoid — with the company floating the unsettling ambition of making robot replicas of loved ones.

Solos unveiled the camera-free AirGo A6 AI glasses plus an AirGo V2 Privacy Kit that physically covers the 16MP camera lens, keeping onboard AI voice assistant and live translation while addressing bystander privacy fears around always-on smart glasses.

Sony revived its bridge camera line with the RX10 V, whose onboard BIONZ XR AI processor drives real-time recognition autofocus that automatically identifies birds and animals, alongside 4K/120fps capture and 30fps burst shooting.

Amazon brought AI reading tools to Kindle first via the iOS app — 'Ask this Book,' a spoiler-free chatbot that answers plot and character questions, and 'Story So Far,' which generates summaries tailored to your current reading position.

Meta will automatically disable the camera on its AI smart glasses if the white LED recording indicator is covered or tampered with, starting on second-gen models, after an underground market emerged for disabling the privacy light.
Gizmodo's best gadgets of June 2026 roundup spotlights the month's standout new hardware, including emerging AI-companion and AI-assistant devices such as the Takway Sweekar virtual-pet gadget.
